hero.label: Boutique Clinical Excellence
hero.subtitle: A boutique experience combining clinical excellence with human warmth. Your well-being is our primary focus, in an environment designed for tranquility.

mission.title: A Philosophy of Comprehensive Care
mission.missionText: To provide clinical excellence with a truly human touch, ensuring that every patient receives top-level care in an environment designed for their absolute comfort and peace of mind.
mission.visionText: To completely reimagine the healthcare experience, transforming every visit into an exceptional moment of well-being, empathy, and lasting trust.

services.title: Cutting-Edge Treatments
services.subtitle: Each treatment is a personalized project, designed to achieve the most natural and lasting results.

esthetic.title: Esthetic Dentistry
esthetic.desc: Smile design and comprehensive health. We transform your smile with state-of-the-art techniques adapted to your unique facial anatomy.

ortho.title: Invisible Orthodontics
ortho.desc: Discreet and comfortable dental alignment with high-precision 3D technology.

whitening.title: Teeth Whitening
whitening.desc: Visible results from the first session with our advanced LED technology.

implants.title: Dental Implants
implants.desc: Permanent functional and aesthetic restoration using the highest quality biocompatible materials. A definitive solution for a complete smile.

work.title: Our Work
work.subtitle: Each case is a story of transformation. Results that speak for themselves.

carlos.quote: I never thought going to the dentist could be so enjoyable. The team is extraordinary and the results are exactly what I dreamed of. My new smile changed my life.

andrea.quote: World-class care in Santa Cruz. Every detail of the treatment was planned with precision and care. Undoubtedly the best investment I have ever made.

philosophy.title: Guizada Aliaga
philosophy.body: Founded with the conviction that medicine must be both an exact science and a human art, Clínica Guizada Aliaga was born from the desire to offer Santa Cruz a space where clinical excellence and personal care meet in perfect harmony.
philosophy.body2: Our team of specialists shares a common philosophy: every patient deserves the time, attention, and respect that transform a medical visit into a genuine experience of well-being.
